name: baseUrl
label: Engine base URL
help: Root URL of your Orch8 engine without a trailing slash and without /api/v1, e.g. `https://orch8.example.com`.

name: apiKey
label: API key
help: Sent as the `x-api-key` header. Use a tenant-scoped key with the `operator` capability (or `approver` if you only resolve approvals).

name: tenantId
label: Tenant ID
help: Sent as the `x-tenant-id` header. Must match the tenant bound to a tenant-scoped API key.
